verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَالذّٰرِیٰتِ ذَرۡوًا ۙ﴿۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]By the winds that scatter seeds with a true scattering,

verses.ar: فَالۡحٰمِلٰتِ وِقۡرًا ۙ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]Then by the clouds that carry the load of moisture,

verses.ar: فَالۡجٰرِیٰتِ یُسۡرًا ۙ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: [✲]Then by the rivers that flow gently,

verses.ar: فَالۡمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمۡرًا ۙ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]And then by the angels that finally administer and execute affairs,
w: and then by the angels that finally administer and execute

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لَصَادِقٌ ۙ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: Surely, that which you are promised is true;

verses.ar: وَّاِنَّ الدِّیۡنَ لَوَاقِعٌ ؕ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: And the Judgment will surely come to pass.

verses.ar: وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الۡحُبُکِ ۙ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: And by the heaven full of tracks,

verses.ar: اِنَّکُمۡ لَفِیۡ قَوۡلٍ مُّخۡتَلِفٍ ۙ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]Truly you are discordant in your utterances.

verses.ar: یُّؤۡفَکُ عَنۡہُ مَنۡ اُفِکَ ﴿ؕ۱۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]He alone is turned away from the truth who is destined to be thus turned away.

verses.ar: قُتِلَ الۡخَرّٰصُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]Cursed be the liars,

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ ہُمۡ فِیۡ غَمۡرَۃٍ سَاہُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]Who are heedless in the depth of ignorance.

verses.ar: یَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ اَیَّانَ یَوۡمُ الدِّیۡنِ ﴿ؕ۱۳﴾
verses.en: They ask: ‘When will be the Day of Judgment?’

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ ہُمۡ عَلَی النَّارِ یُفۡتَنُوۡنَ ﴿۱۴﴾
verses.en: It will be the day when they will be tormented at the Fire.

verses.ar: ذُوۡقُوۡا فِتۡنَتَکُمۡ ؕ ہٰذَا الَّذِیۡ کُنۡتُمۡ بِہٖ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘Taste ye your torment. This is what you would hasten.’

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ فِیۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُیُوۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۱۶﴾
verses.en: But surely the righteous will be in the midst of gardens and springs,
w: will be in the midst of

verses.ar: اٰخِذِیۡنَ مَاۤ اٰتٰہُمۡ رَبُّہُمۡ ؕ اِنَّہُمۡ کَانُوۡا قَبۡلَ ذٰلِکَ مُحۡسِنِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۱۷﴾
verses.en: Receiving what their Lord will give them; for they used to do good before that.

verses.ar: کَانُوۡا قَلِیۡلًا مِّنَ الَّیۡلِ مَا یَہۡجَعُوۡنَ ﴿۱۸﴾
verses.en: They used to sleep but a little of the night;

verses.ar: وَبِالۡاَسۡحَارِ ہُمۡ یَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: And at the dawn of the day they sought forgiveness;
w: and at the dawn of the day

verses.ar: وَفِیۡۤ اَمۡوَالِہِمۡ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَالۡمَحۡرُوۡمِ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And in their wealth was a share for one who asked for help and for one who could not.
w: for one who asked for help

verses.ar: وَفِی الۡاَرۡضِ اٰیٰتٌ لِّلۡمُوۡقِنِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۱﴾
verses.en: And in the earth are Signs for those who have certainty of faith,
w: for those who have certainty of faith

verses.ar: وَفِیۡۤ اَنۡفُسِکُمۡ ؕ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: And also in your own selves. Will you not then see?

verses.ar: وَفِی السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُکُمۡ وَمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: And in heaven is your sustenance, and also that which you are promised.

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِنَّہٗ لَحَقٌّ مِّثۡلَ مَاۤ اَنَّکُمۡ تَنۡطِقُوۡنَ ﴿٪۲۴﴾
verses.en: And by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is certainly the truth, even as it is true that you speak.

verses.ar: ہَلۡ اَتٰٮکَ حَدِیۡثُ ضَیۡفِ اِبۡرٰہِیۡمَ الۡمُکۡرَمِیۡنَ ﴿ۘ۲۵﴾
verses.en: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached thee?

verses.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَیۡہِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا ؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ ۚ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡکَرُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۲۶﴾
verses.en: When they entered upon him and said, ‘Peace!’ he said, ‘Peace!’ They were all strangers.

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ اِلٰۤی اَہۡلِہٖ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ سَمِیۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۲۷﴾
verses.en: And he went quietly to his household, and brought a fatted calf,

verses.ar: فَقَرَّبَہٗۤ اِلَیۡہِمۡ قَالَ اَلَا تَاۡکُلُوۡنَ ﴿۫۲۸﴾
verses.en: And he placed it before them. He said, ‘Will you not eat?’

verses.ar: فَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡہُمۡ خِیۡفَۃً ؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ ؕ وَبَشَّرُوۡہُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِیۡمٍ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]And he felt a fear on account of them. They said, ‘Fear not.’ And they gave him glad tidings of the birth of a son possessing knowledge.
w: and they gave him glad tidings

verses.ar: فَاَقۡبَلَتِ امۡرَاَتُہٗ فِیۡ صَرَّۃٍ فَصَکَّتۡ وَجۡہَہَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوۡزٌ عَقِیۡمٌ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: Then his wife came forward crying and smote her face and said, ‘A barren old woman!’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا کَذٰلِکِ ۙ قَالَ رَبُّکِ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡحَکِیۡمُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Even so has thy Lord said. Surely, He is the Wise, the All-Knowing.’

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُکُمۡ اَیُّہَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿۳۲﴾
verses.en: Abraham said, ‘Now what is your errand, O ye messengers?’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡنَاۤ اِلٰی قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۳﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘We have been sent to a sinful people,

verses.ar: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ حِجَارَۃً مِّنۡ طِیۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۳۴﴾
verses.en: ‘That we may send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَۃً عِنۡدَ رَبِّکَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِیۡنَ ﴿۳۵﴾
verses.en: ‘Marked, with thy Lord, for those guilty of excesses.’

verses.ar: فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مَنۡ کَانَ فِیۡہَا مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۶﴾
verses.en: And We brought forth therefrom such of the believers as were there,

verses.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِیۡہَا غَیۡرَ بَیۡتٍ مِّنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۷﴾
verses.en: And We found not there except only one house of Muslims.

verses.ar: وَتَرَکۡنَا فِیۡہَاۤ اٰیَۃً لِّلَّذِیۡنَ یَخَافُوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِیۡمَ ﴿ؕ۳۸﴾
verses.en: And We left therein a Sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.ar: وَفِیۡ مُوۡسٰۤی اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنٰہُ اِلٰی فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿۳۹﴾
verses.en: And We left another Sign in Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority,

verses.ar: فَتَوَلّٰی بِرُکۡنِہٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌ ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]But he turned away from Moses in his pride of power, and said, ‘A sorcerer, or a madman.’

verses.ar: فَاَخَذۡنٰہُ وَجُنُوۡدَہٗ فَنَبَذۡنٰہُمۡ فِی الۡیَمِّ وَہُوَ مُلِیۡمٌ ﴿ؕ۴۱﴾
verses.en: So We seized him and his hosts and threw them into the sea; and he himself was to blame.

verses.ar: وَفِیۡ عَادٍ اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمُ الرِّیۡحَ الۡعَقِیۡمَ ﴿ۚ۴۲﴾
verses.en: And there was a Sign in the tribe of ‘Ad, when We sent against them the destructive wind.

verses.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِنۡ شَیۡءٍ اَتَتۡ عَلَیۡہِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتۡہُ کَالرَّمِیۡمِ ﴿ؕ۴۳﴾
verses.en: It left nothing whatever that it visited, but made it like a rotten bone.

verses.ar: وَفِیۡ ثَمُوۡدَ اِذۡ قِیۡلَ لَہُمۡ تَمَتَّعُوۡا حَتّٰی حِیۡنٍ ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: And a Sign there was in the tribe of Thamud when it was said to them, ‘Enjoy yourselves for a while.’

verses.ar: فَعَتَوۡا عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّہِمۡ فَاَخَذَتۡہُمُ الصّٰعِقَۃُ وَہُمۡ یَنۡظُرُوۡنَ ﴿۴۵﴾
verses.en: But they rebelled against the command of their Lord. So the thunderbolt overtook them while they gazed;

verses.ar: فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مِنۡ قِیَامٍ وَّمَا کَانُوۡا مُنۡتَصِرِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۶﴾
verses.en: And they were not able to rise again, nor could they defend themselves.

verses.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ ؕ اِنَّہُمۡ کَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِیۡنَ ﴿٪۴۷﴾
verses.en: And We destroyed the people of Noah before them; they were a disobedient people.

verses.ar: وَالسَّمَآءَ بَنَیۡنٰہَا بِاَیۡٮدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوۡسِعُوۡنَ ﴿۴۸﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We have built the heaven with Our own hands, and verily We have vast powers.

verses.ar: وَالۡاَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنٰہَا فَنِعۡمَ الۡمٰہِدُوۡنَ ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: And the earth We have spread out, and how excellently do We prepare things!

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَیۡنِ لَعَلَّکُمۡ تَذَکَّرُوۡنَ ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: And of everything have We created pairs, that you may reflect.

verses.ar: فَفِرُّوۡۤا اِلَی اللّٰہِ ؕ اِنِّیۡ لَکُمۡ مِّنۡہُ نَذِیۡرٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۚ۵۱﴾
verses.en: Flee ye therefore unto Allah. Surely, I am a plain Warner unto you from Him.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰہِ اِلٰـہًا اٰخَرَ ؕ اِنِّیۡ لَکُمۡ مِّنۡہُ نَذِیۡرٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۚ۵۲﴾
verses.en: And do not set up another God along with Allah. Surely, I am a plain Warner unto you from Him.

verses.ar: کَذٰلِکَ مَاۤ اَتَی الَّذِیۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِہِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوۡا سَاحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌ ﴿ۚ۵۳﴾
verses.en: Even so there came no Messenger to those before them, but they said, ‘A sorcerer, or a madman!’

verses.ar: اَتَوَاصَوۡا بِہٖ ۚ بَلۡ ہُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۵۴﴾
verses.en: Have they made it a legacy to one another? Nay, they are all a rebellious people.
w: have they made a legacy to one another

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡہُمۡ فَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِمَلُوۡمٍ ﴿٭۫۵۵﴾
verses.en: So turn away from them; and there will be no blame on thee.

verses.ar: وَّذَکِّرۡ فَاِنَّ الذِّکۡرٰی تَنۡفَعُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۵۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]And keep on exhorting; for verily, exhortation benefits those who would believe.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ الۡجِنَّ وَالۡاِنۡسَ اِلَّا لِیَعۡبُدُوۡنِ ﴿۵۷﴾
verses.en: And I have not created the Jinn and the men but that they may worship Me.

verses.ar: مَاۤ اُرِیۡدُ مِنۡہُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّزۡقٍ وَّمَاۤ اُرِیۡدُ اَنۡ یُّطۡعِمُوۡنِ ﴿۵۸﴾
verses.en: I desire no sustenance from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me.

verses.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰہَ ہُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الۡقُوَّۃِ الۡمَتِیۡنُ ﴿۵۹﴾
verses.en: Surely, it is Allah Himself Who is the Great Sustainer, the Powerful, the Strong.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِیۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذَنُوۡبًا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوۡبِ اَصۡحٰبِہِمۡ فَلَا یَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ ﴿۶۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And for those who do wrong there is a share of comfort like the share enjoyed by their fellows of the earlier times; so let them not ask Me to hasten on the punishment.
w: let them ask Me to hasten

verses.ar: فَوَیۡلٌ لِّلَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ یَّوۡمِہِمُ الَّذِیۡ یُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ﴿٪۶۱﴾
verses.en: Woe, then, to those who disbelieve, because of that day of theirs which they have been promised!
